free_tier.stated: not stated on https://cloud.google.com/products/compute/pricing/accelerator-optimized (read 2026-10-30): the page is a price sheet that bills every GPU machine type by the hour, for example a2-ultragpu-1g (one A100) at USD 5.06879789 an hour on demand, and prints no free allowance
free_tier.notes: The Free Tier document says 'GPUs and TPUs are not included in the Free Tier offer.', and a non-billable Free Trial account cannot add GPUs to VM instances, so the USD 300 Welcome credit does not reach a GPU before the account is upgraded. After the upgrade to a Paid billing account the same document says GPUs are unlocked and the remaining credit stays usable on products and services covered by the Free Trial for the original 90 days from sign-up; its list of what the credit cannot pay for names Gemini API in AI Studio and managed-API partner models, not GPUs, and a Google Cloud Support reply states the credit is applied to GPU usage after the upgrade, so the credit pays for GPU time (inferred from that exclusion list and the support reply; no page prices a GPU against the credit).

limits.value: one A100 (a2-ultragpu-1g) at USD 5.06879789 an hour on demand; eight-GPU H100 nodes at USD 88.490000119 an hour (a3-highgpu-8g) and USD 93.400712807 an hour (a3-megagpu-8g) on demand
no free-tier allowance applies to any GPU or TPU; billing starts with the first second

identity_cost.detail: Free Trial signup requires a credit card or other payment method, and the upgrade to a Paid billing account that GPU and Windows Server VMs need is made on that billing account

confidence_note: both the accelerator-optimized rate card and the free-features document were read on 2026-10-22. The page proves the per-GPU rate and the free-features document proves there is no free GPU allowance

evidence.proved: 'GPUs and TPUs are not included in the Free Tier offer. You are always charged for GPUs and TPUs that you add to VM instances' (free-features document), against the accelerator-optimized rate card read the same day: a2-ultragpu-1g at $5.06879789 an hour on demand
the accelerator-optimized price sheet bills a one-A100 a2-ultragpu-1g at USD 5.06879789 an hour on demand; the page prints no free allowance
evidence.quote: a2-ultragpu-1g | Nvidia A100 | GPUs: 1 vCPUs: 12 Memory: 170GB SSD: 275 GiB | $5.06879789 / 1 hour

evidence.proved: the Google Cloud Free Tier excludes GPUs
evidence.quote: GPUs and TPUs are not included in the Free Tier offer.

evidence.proved: while the billing account is a non-billable Free Trial account, GPUs cannot be added to VM instances
evidence.quote: Add GPUs to your VM instances.

evidence.proved: an eight-H100 a3-highgpu-8g is billed USD 88.490000119 an hour on demand, below the a3-megagpu-8g at USD 93.400712807
evidence.quote: a3-highgpu-8g | Nvidia H100 | GPUs: 8 vCPUs: 208 Memory: 1,871GB SSD: 6,000 GiB | $88.490000119 / 1 hour

evidence.proved: after the upgrade to a Paid billing account the remaining credit stays usable on products and services covered by the Free Trial, within 90 days of sign-up
evidence.quote: Your remaining credit is available for use on [products and services covered by the Free Trial](https://docs.cloud.google.com/free/docs/free-cloud-features#during-free-trial), but they must be consumed within the original 90 days period from your sign-up date.

evidence.proved: the credit has its own exclusion list, which names Gemini API in AI Studio and managed-API partner models, and neither GPUs nor Windows Server images
evidence.quote: The $300 credit can't be used for the following

evidence.proved: the Free Trial terms let an upgraded customer keep using unused credit for the Services, expiring 3 months after the Free Trial start
evidence.quote: Customer may continue to use the credits for the Services (subject to the limitations described at the Free Trial Description Page). Any unused credits will expire 3 months after the Free Trial Start Date.

evidence.proved: upgrading to a Paid billing account unlocks GPUs, which a non-billable Free Trial account cannot add
evidence.quote: Google Cloud access unlocked: You gain access to all Google Cloud products and services, including those products and services that were restricted during the Free Trial, such as GPUs, Google Cloud Marketplace, and third-party generative AI models.

evidence.proved: a Google Cloud Support reply (2017) states the remaining free-trial credit is applied to GPU usage after the upgrade
evidence.quote: Free-trial credits are applicable to any Google Cloud Platform services (including GPU), so even after the upgrade the remainder free credit will be utilized against any GCP services in use (including GPU).

evidence.proved: the Free Trial signup, which precedes the upgrade, requires a credit card or other payment method
evidence.quote: During the sign up, you must provide a credit card or other payment method that is valid for the period of the Free Trial.

shape.note: each accelerator-optimized type fixes its own ratio; a2-ultragpu-1g is 1 GPU, 12 vCPU, 170 GB, 275 GiB SSD

session_cap.note: no free allowance and no session cap; a GPU VM bills until it is stopped or deleted
